The user wants me to act as Evidence Critic and check each claim against the cited evidence. I need to flag only factual problems: overstatements, wrong numbers/dates/suppliers, causes not stated, products/NDCs not in evidence. Reasonable conclusions from cited facts are supported.

Let me examine each claim:

Claim 1: investigator: "Our package NDC 65219-368-24 has 77 units on hand covering 8.2 days at 9.4 units per day." Cited: [stock-43]

Evidence says: "lorazepam LORAZEPAM 2 mg/mL (Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, NDC 65219-368-24, ANDA217598, DEA schedule CIV): 77 units on hand, 9.4/day over 30 days, 8.2 days of cover"

Matches exactly. Supported.

Claim 2: investigator: "No ongoing recall for this NDC." Cited: [search-recall-43]

Evidence says: "Searched this run's FDA ongoing-recall snapshot for our package NDC 65219-368-24 and product 65219-368: no ongoing recall."

Matches. Supported.

Claim 3: investigator: "A different Fresenius Kabi presentation (NDC 65219-368-02) shows Available on the FDA shortage list; 9 of 10 presentations from other makers are limited or unavailable and are not our package." Cited: [shortage-65219-368-02, market-43]

Evidence [shortage-65219-368-02] says: "FDA shortage list: Lorazepam, Injection, 2 mg/1 mL (NDC 65219-368-02) from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC; availability: "Available"; Check wholesalers for inventory; updated 10/15/2026"

Evidence [market-43] says: "FDA shortage list context for lorazepam: 9 of 10 presentations from other makers listed limited or unavailable. These are not our package."

The claim says "A different Fresenius Kabi presentation (NDC 65219-368-02) shows Available on the FDA shortage list" - matches evidence [shortage-65219-368-02] which shows NDC 65219-368-02 is Available. It's a different NDC from our package (65219-368-24). So that part is supported.

"9 of 10 presentations from other makers are limited or unavailable and are not our package." Evidence [market-43] says "9 of 10 presentations from other makers listed limited or unavailable. These are not our package." Matches.

All claims appear supported. No factual problems. So unsupported list empty.
